Your alphanumeric App ID from developers.deriv.com → Dashboard → Applications (e.g. 33ADPhDZXR2F60qhPudXB). Used in REST API headers for trading authentication. Register a PAT-type app if you don't have one.

No longer required — Deriv's public analysis feed (wss://api.derivws.com/trading/v1/options/ws/public) doesn't take an App ID. This field is kept for backward compatibility only and has no effect on live digits.

Your Personal Access Token (PAT) from developers.deriv.com → Dashboard → API tokens. Create a PAT with trade and account_manage scopes. This is used as a Bearer token to authenticate all REST and WebSocket calls.
